messages:
maya: 👀 found a broken import in examples/embeddings/README.md — snippet still uses `redwood_client` which was removed. New hires hit this on first run.

sam: Yikes. Can you paste the exact block?

maya: ```python
from redwood_client import EmbeddingClient
client = EmbeddingClient(api_key=\"<KEY>\")
```

maya: It should be:

```python
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
client = EmbeddingsClient(api_key_or_token=\"${REDWOOD_API_KEY}\")
```

liam: That will break onboarding flows. Also add a short header note: "Replace placeholders with env vars (e.g., ${REDWOOD_API_KEY}); avoid pasting secrets into code."

engineer_jordan: I'll open a small PR: fix the Python snippet, sync the JS sample (parity: `RedwoodClient` -> `Redwood`), and add a lightweight GH Action smoke test that runs `python -c \"import redwood; print(\'ok\')\"` in /examples on 3.9 and 3.11.

sam: Only run the action for changes under /examples/** and on PRs/push to main to avoid CI churn.

docs: Please add a brief changelog entry under docs/quickstart and tag onboarding/docs:urgent so SEs can update training.

engineer_jordan: Plan for PR: README fixes (py + js), add header warning, add smoke action matrix (3.9,3.11), changelog note, and a one-line PR title: "copy/paste import fix".

liam: Also add a checklist item to the sample PR template reminding authors to run examples locally or add smoke checks. Low friction, prevents regressions.

maya: Ping this thread when PR is up so we can fast-track merge. Small, low-risk patch.

sam: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
